verdict.rationale: NVIDIA does document a programmatic interface for the RTX 5080 via the CUDA Toolkit (C++/Python tile APIs, compiler, runtime library), which lets developers programmatically drive GPU compute — a form of public API. However, there is no evidence of a higher-level agentic/REST/OpenAPI-style interface for AI-native automation, and probes explicitly show 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json and docs-md endpoints, indicating no modern machine-readable API spec. missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI or agent-facing API, evidence of AI-native tooling driving the GPU beyond low-level CUDA programming, independent confirmation of API usage for automation.
